author: sensrcn
body:
The constructor initializes boost_ by calling GetInvLorentzBoost(), which reads verbosity_. Since verbosity_ was declared after boost_, it was read before initialization, triggering the UBSAN error reported in #51974.

Move verbosity_ before boost_ in the member declarations and initializer list.

Tested: scram b -j 8 in CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3.
title: Fix uninitialized verbosity read in BetaBoostEvtVtxGenerator
